# Action bar
The row of slots at the top of your screen. Each slot holds one action: something you can click or press a key to do. Abilities from your species, items in your hands, combat mode, emotes, everything goes here.
## Shape and look
[color=yellow]Settings > Misc > Action Bar[/color] is where you shape it:
- [color=#a4885c]Rows[/color] and [color=#a4885c]Slots per row[/color] decide how many buttons you see and how they wrap. Default is one row of ten. - [color=#a4885c]Slot spacing[/color] is the gap between buttons. - [color=#a4885c]Show keybind label[/color] toggles the little key letter in the corner of each slot. - [color=#a4885c]Show empty slots (faint)[/color] draws the outline of unused slots so the layout is always visible.
The background opacity lives over in [color=yellow]Settings > Accessibility[/color] next to the other UI opacity sliders.
## Hotkeys
Default keys are [color=yellow][bold]1-0[/bold][/color] for the first row and [color=yellow][bold]Shift+1-0[/bold][/color] for the second. Any of those can be rebound.
Two ways to rebind:
1. The direct way. [color=yellow]Settings > Controls[/color] has an [color=#a4885c]Assign action bar slot hotkeys[/color] checkbox at the top. Tick it, click any slot on the bar, then press the key you want. Done. The matching [color=#a4885c]Hotbar 1[/color], [color=#a4885c]Hotbar Shift 1[/color], etc. row in the same options panel updates to match. 2. The traditional way. Scroll down in [color=yellow]Settings > Controls[/color] and click the key field next to [color=#a4885c]Hotbar 1[/color] / [color=#a4885c]Hotbar Shift 1[/color] / etc. and press a key.
Either way writes the same keybind. The slot's label updates immediately.
## Locking and auto-add
The actions window (open with [color=yellow][bold][keybind="OpenActionsMenu"][/bold][/color]) has two checkboxes:
- [color=#a4885c]Lock bar[/color] stops right-click-clear and drag-to-rearrange. Clicking a slot to fire its action still works; the layout just can't be nudged by mis-clicks. - [color=#a4885c]Auto-add new actions[/color] controls whether picking up an item or getting a new ability auto-populates onto the bar. Off means the action still appears in the actions menu but stays out of your curated hotbar.
## Emotes
Your emotes (the set you'd see in the radial emote menu) also show up in the actions menu as draggable buttons. The filter dropdown in that window has an [color=#a4885c]Emote[/color] checkbox so you can look at just emotes.
Drag one onto a hotbar slot. It sticks. Rebind the slot's key via either method above. From then on that key plays the emote, same as typing the emote command.
Emote placements are remembered across disconnects and server restarts, so a layout you spent time on isn't wasted when the round ends.
